name: Vespid Dynamics Corrosive Launcher CL-3 'Acid Reign'
description: A grenade-launcher-format weapon that fires encapsulated payloads of binary corrosive compound. Each round contains two separated chemical chambers that mix upon impact, creating a highly exothermic acid reaction that dissolves most metals, polymers, and organic materials within a 2-meter splash radius. The binary design means the individual components are relatively safe to handle and store — the danger only manifests on impact mixing. Vespid developed it for rapid structural demolition, but its anti-vehicle and anti-personnel applications have dominated field use.
specifications:
launcher type: Break-action single shot
round diameter: 40mm encapsulated binary
splash radius: 2 meters
corrosion rate: 3mm structural steel per minute
effective range: 30-100 meters
weight: 3.5 kg
neutralization time: Compound becomes inert after 8 minutes
story_hooks: A building's structural supports were pre-weakened with CL-3 acid rounds days before a scheduled demolition — someone ensured the building would collapse ahead of schedule, with people still inside.
A modified CL-3 round has been developed that produces a corrosive gas rather than liquid — turning it from a point weapon into an area denial tool.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist single-shot grenade launcher with a distinctly organic, almost insectoid aesthetic befitting its Vespid branding. The barrel is oversized and ribbed, designed to safely contain and chamber the volatile binary payloads. The break-action mechanism dominates the rear, with a prominent thumb-lever for loading. It reads as intentionally intimidating—industrial, purposeful, and unambiguously dangerous.
physical_description.dimensions: 68cm overall length, 38cm barrel, 12cm across the breach assembly at widest point
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty without being unwieldy—3.5kg feels substantial in the hands, balanced between the barrel mass and the reinforced receiver. The weight distribution suggests controlled deployment rather than rapid fire, every shot deliberate.
physical_description.primary_material: Hardened steel chassis with carbon-composite barrel shroud; reinforced polymer grip module rated for caustic splash exposure
physical_description.finish: Matte industrial gunmetal with heat-stress discoloration streaking the upper barrel surface. The polymer components show a satin black finish with faint scuff marks from field use. Intentionally void of reflective surfaces—designed to absorb rather than catch light.
physical_description.color_scheme: Slate gray barrel with deep matte black polymer accents; accent striping in acid-yellow along the safety lever and chamber markings as a chemical hazard indicator
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured non-slip polymer with embedded micro-ridges, engineered to remain stable even when contaminated with splash residue. Slightly tacky, designed for gloved operation.
distinctive_features: Oversized ribbed barrel with visible thermal dissipation grooves
Prominent biohazard/chemical warning decals in yellow and black
Binary chamber indicator window showing dual-chamber status
Thumb-lever break-action mechanism with redundant safety catch
Score marks and chemical etch patterns on the lower receiver from field exposure
Heat-discolored streaking suggesting multiple field deployments
Reinforced ejector port with splash guard lip
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS corporate logo (stylized wasp silhouette) stamped prominently on the left receiver. Serial number and production date acid-etched into a recessed plate on the right side. 'CL-3 ACID REIGN' designation laser-marked on the barrel shroud in small capitals.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but field-worn; evidence of careful cleaning and storage balanced against use-scarring. The polymer shows minor discoloration from chemical exposure, but the mechanism remains tight. A working tool of a professional demolitions contractor or militant operative—neither pristine nor neglected.
